extracted.name: Easy Roasted Pork
extracted.description: Here is a delicious recipe for a moist, sweet pork loin roast prepared in a handy oven bag.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Lightly flour an oven bag.
Combine brown sugar, applesauce, and ginger in a small bowl.
Add pork roast to the prepared bag; pour brown sugar mixture over roast. Seal bag; place in a roasting pan. Cut several small slits in top of bag.
Cook in the preheated oven until an instant-read thermometer inserted into the center reads 145 degrees F (63 degrees C), about 1 hour.
